main_measure.name: t of the slope of excess 5-day return on the forecast (forecast > 0, non-overlapping grid)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope t >= 2 (with Welch t >= 2); reject: slope t <= -2 or Welch t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess 5-day return after prior 5-day return <= 0 minus after > 0, Welch t

decided_by: Neither rule met (slope t 1.33, Welch t 2.16): any other result is inconclusive.
reading: The coin's mean 5-day return is taken over all grid bars of all its windows; the regression uses every positive-forecast grid case with a 5-day forward return in its window, while the prior-return groups use only those with a prior 5-day return inside the window; the plan's minimum counts give 'not observable'.
